selection: 45 candidates: majority, 32 matched logistic pipelines and 12 RBF SVM pipelines. Select encoder/AV fusion/model settings by pooled inner accuracy, then five-class macro-F1, then declared order. Only the selected pipeline is scored on each outer fold.
calibration: RBF SVM probabilities use sigmoid calibration from 3 stratified shuffled fitting-only folds, with a fold-local scaler inside each SVM pipeline. ensemble=False fits a final SVM to all fitting rows. Each SVM pipeline.fit entails 4 base SVM fits. No hidden libsvm probability fitting. Learned probabilities and predicted classes use the same argmax.
encoder: Fixed public MPNet and previous fixed MiniLM. Both cover all text tokens using nonoverlapping 254-token chunks and length-weighted normalized mean pooling. No encoder fine-tuning; no private text uploads. MPNet general pretraining overlap remains unknown.
limits: Post-final exploratory development, fixed five-class targets, unchanged 163 training participants and nested folds. All 275 participants / 281 physical sources are covered in feature preparation. No new validation/test evaluation, full-training refit or reference replacement. No search expansion after outer results. 55% is a target, not a guarantee or independent result.
